title: Polynomial families of incident flags and explicit off-diagonal Ramsey graphs
summary: We construct explicit off-diagonal Ramsey graphs from polynomial families of incident point--hyperplane flags. Universal interpolation translates the exact dimension of ordered clique configurations into a bound on their coefficient--label incidence. At the critical dimension, a polynomial separates the forbidden-pair image from its diagonal; deleting the corresponding edges preserves a triangular rank certificate.
